unsupported: Electronic Interconnect (EI) operates from a single facility in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, where it has fabricated printed circuit boards for more than 30 years.

The shop offers HDI laser micro vias, controlled impedance, blind/buried vias, back drilling, heavy copper, hybrid RF/digital stack-ups, metal-clad thermal substrates, and a full menu of surface finishes including ENIG, ENEPIG, immersion tin, and selective gold.
The customer base spans aerospace and defense (AS9100D, ITAR registration), medical devices (ISO 13485 compliance), telecommunications, industrial controls, and contract electronics assembly.
